name_en: Puratchi Thalaivar M.G.R. Nutritious Meal Programme (school noon meal)
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Your child gets a free hot cooked lunch at school, five days a week, about 210 days a year. Meals include variety rice and eggs.

other: Your child studies in a government school, government aided school, or a few other listed schools (special training centres, madarasas, maktabs, child labour special schools).
Class 1 to Class 10 (primary, upper primary and high school).

how_to_apply: You do not need to apply. The meal is served at the school.
where_to_apply: At your child's school noon meal centre.
helpline: For complaints, call your district Collectorate toll-free number. In Karur district it is 1800 425 2556.
